entries.67df66a9d5a2e216: The education industry faces a shrinking market due to the declining birthrate and intensifying competition. Within this, the company's group's largest business is the High School Students Division, whose revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,487 million, about half of operating revenue. Next are the Sports Business Division at ¥17,798 million, the Elementary and Junior High School Students Division at ¥13,351 million, the Business School Division at ¥2,000 million, and Other at ¥1,545 million. Disclosure of revenue by region is omitted because Japan accounts for over 9 tenths, and there is no major customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
